summary: Add opt-in staleness refresh (--refresh-stale / FOODPANDA_AUTO_REFRESH) with a sync_state.last_params column.
reason: The CLI reads a local SQLite mirror with no self-healing path. Refresh is geo-scoped, so sync_state gained last_params to record the coordinates a sync used; without it a refresh would mirror a different place than the user synced. Default off so a read command never silently reaches the network.
validated_outcome: 6 new freshness tests pass; scorecard cache_freshness 5/10 -> 10/10; live dogfood full 108/108.
